rationale: Ground truth shows this PR had no real concerns (human reviewer just said 'lgtm'), so a clean, verified approve like X's is the accurate call — X grounds every claim in actual greps and an upstream checkout comparison. Y is more actionable (concrete file/line fix suggestions) but manufactures three 'minor/nit' findings on a trivial rename PR, including a claim about an import comment at api_server.py:65 that falls entirely outside the provided diff and cannot be verified, plus a pre-existing diffusion-mode edge case Y itself admits isn't a regression — this scope creep and unverifiable claim drag down precision relative to X's tightly grounded review.
